svg.text: Cut 30 long from one reel of 2.0 soft aluminium wire;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: file the ends square, no burr.

svg.text: Never use steel wire, a nail or a bolt: the pin is

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the safety device that limits the pull.

svg.text: in a test fork: all must break 256 to 347 N.
